query_construction: deterministic TF-IDF salient-term extraction over the full frozen facts-only text: segment by sentence/paragraph, remove procedural-report boilerplate, score unigrams by segment TF-IDF with a mild within-document frequency factor, retain section/article cues, and select at most 32 unique terms
legacy_query_construction: legacy-first-32-terms-v1 (retained only to reproduce the Week 9 final regression)
eligibility_requirement: strictly earlier decision year; applied to the BM25 candidate relation before ORDER BY/LIMIT 100
redundancy_rule: select at most one chunk per source_id
ordering: descending BM25 score; retain original retrieval rank as deterministic tie-breaker
direct_content_self_match_rule: Exclude a content self-match only when at least 100 six-token phrase occurrences overlap and at least 80% of the candidate source's unique six-token fingerprints occur in the query case. This preserves true self-copy protection while retaining an earlier authority substantially quoted in a later query judgment.
rationale: A small, source-diverse evidence set is easier to inspect and reduces adjacent-passage duplication without adding a learned reranker. The final bounded temporal-ordering test applies the existing strict earlier-year rule before BM25 ranking so future and same-year documents cannot consume the top-100 depth. On the 30-case frozen answer-key cohort it improved Recall@5 from 5/30 to 12/30, Recall@100 from 12/30 to 15/30, and expected authorities selected from 11/30 to 12/30, with no regression among the original 12 retrieval successes. No further retrieval configuration changes are permitted.
